sa: क्षणेन प्रेक्षतां तेषां विशल्यः सोऽभवत् तदा। तद् दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताः सर्वे वासुदेवपुरोगमाः॥ सह तैर्मुनिभिः सर्वैस्तदा व्यासादिभिर्नृप।
en: Within a short time, the eniire body of Bhishma became arrowless and soreless. Seeing it, all those great personages, headed by Vasudeva, and all the ascetics with Vyasa, became filled with wonder.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हवींषि श्राद्धकल्पे तु यानि श्राद्धविदो विदुः। तानि मे शृणु काम्यानि फलं चैव युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Hear me, O Yudhishthira, what those Havis are which persons conversant with the ritual of the Shraddha consider as suitable for the Shraddha and what the fruits are of each.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच पर्याप्तो मे वरो ह्येष यदहं दृष्टवान् हरिम्॥ पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यं स्रष्टारं जगतः प्रभुम्।
en: (Uttanka said), “It is (already) a great boon to me that you have become visible to me, you who are Hari, the eternal being, the celestials creator, the lord of the universe."

sa: भीमसेनस्तथेत्युक्त्वा तं देशं प्रत्यपद्यत॥ यत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्रा भ्रातरोऽस्य निपातिताः। तान् दृष्ट्वा दुःखितो भीमस्तृषया च प्रपीडितः॥
en: May you be blessed.” Saying “be it so" Bhimasena proceeded towards that place, where his brothers, those most valiant of men, lay dead. Afflicted at seeing them (dead) and oppressed with thirst.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तीर्थानां च फलं राजन् गुणोत्पत्तिं च सर्वशः। मयोच्यमानं वै पुण्यं शृणु राजेन्द्र कृत्स्नशः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The account of the characteristics and origin of all these Tirthas, O king, is very lengthy. I shall, however, describe them to you. Listen to that sacred account, O king.

sa: ततस्तु नागं धरणीधराभं मदं स्रवन्तं जलदप्रकाशम्। गदां समाविद्ध्य भृशं जघान पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतस्तरस्वी॥ तु तदा गजेन्द्रे
en: The active prince of the Panchala, approaching, began to strike with his mace that animal which was huge as a hill and which shed temporal juice like a mass of pouring clouds.

sa: च्यवन उवाच वरश्च गृह्यतां मत्तो यश्च ते संशयो हृदि। तं प्रब्रूहि नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वं सम्पादयामि ते॥
en: Chyavana said Do you accept a boon from me. Do you also, O king, tell me what the doubt is that is in your mind. I shall certainly accomplish all your purposes.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच प्रालीयत ततो व्यान: पुनश्च प्रचचार ह। प्राणापानावुदानश्च समानश्च तमब्रुवन्। न त्वं श्रेष्ठोऽसि नो व्यान समानस्तु वशे तव॥ प्रचचार पुनर्व्यानः समानः पुनरब्रवीत्। श्रेष्ठोऽहमस्मि सर्वेषां श्रूयतां येन हेतुना॥ मयि प्रलीने प्रलयं व्रजन्ति सर्वे प्राणाः प्राणभृतां शरीरे। मयि प्रचीर्णे च पुनश्चरन्ति श्रेष्ठो ह्यहं पश्यत मां प्रलीनम्॥
en: Then Vyana became extinct and once more began to move about. At this, Prana and Apana and Udana and Samana Addressed him, saying. You are not the foremost among us, O Vyana! (Only) Samana is under your dominion. Vyana then began to move about and Saman said to him, I am the foremost of you all! Listen, for what reason. When I become extinct, all the vital airs become extinct in the bodies of living creatures. When I begin to move about, they once more move about. Hence, I am the forcmost. See, I become extinct.

sa: समुद्राश्चापि चत्वारः समानीताश्च दर्भिणा। तेषु सातो नरश्रेष्ठ न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥ फलानि गोसहस्राणां चतुर्णां विन्दते च सः।
en: O foremost of men, Darbhi had brought there also the four oceans. Bathing in them one does not meet with any calamity. He obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: अगस्त्यशास्तामभितो दिशं तु शिरांसि तेषां कुरुसत्तमानाम्। कुन्ती पुरस्तात् तु बभूव तेषां पादान्तरे चाथ बभूव कृष्णा॥
en: The foremost of Kuru princes laid themselves down with their heads towards the south. Kunti laid herself down along the line of their heads and Krishna (Draupadi) along that of their feet.

sa: एतासां प्रजानां पालयिता यशस्वी सुरर्षीणामथ सम्मतो भृशम्। एतस्मात् पार्थात् पुरुषो जनिष्यति कपोतरोमेति च तस्य नाम॥
en: Earning great fame and being respected by ! the celestial, you will long rule over these men. A son will be born to you from your side who will be named Kapotaraman.

sa: तत्रापि विधिवद् दत्त्वा विप्रेभ्यो रत्नसंचयान्॥ प्रायात् प्राची दिशं तत्र तत्र तीर्थान्यनेकशः। सहस्रशतसंख्यानि प्रथितानि पदे पदे॥
en: Duly distributing many valuable articles there amongst the Brahmanas Baladeva then set out with face towards the east and reached, one after another, hundreds and thousands of celebrated tirthas situated all around.

sa: लुब्धक उवाच अस्मादेकाद् बहवो रक्षितव्या नैको बहुभ्यो गौतमि रक्षितव्यः। कृतागसं धर्मविदस्त्यजन्ति सरीसृपं पापमिमं जहि त्वम्॥
en: The fowler replied A great number (of creatures)should be safeguarded against this one, instead of this single creature being protected. Virtuous men quit the vicious: do you, therefore, destroy the wicked creature.

sa: दमात् सिद्धिं परीप्सन्तो मां जनाः कामयन्ति ह। दिवं चोर्वी च मध्यं च तस्माद् दामोदरो ह्यहम्॥
en: Desirous of acquiring success through control of their senses, people seek to obtain to me who am heaven and Earth and the sky between the two. For this am I called Damodara.

sa: गते तु शोकात् त्रिदिवं नराधिपे महीतलस्थासु नृपाङ्गनासु च। निवृत्तचारः सहसा गतो रविः प्रवृत्तचारा रजनी ह्युपस्थिता॥
en: On the lord of men having ascended heaven from grief, and the wives of the king remaining on the earth, the sun, his journey done, set, and the night began her course.

sa: निश्चित्य मनसा कृत्यं सा सम्यगिति भामिनी। मन्थरायै शनैः सर्वमाचचक्षे विचक्षणा॥ सा दीना निश्चयं कृत्वा मन्थरावाक्यमोहिता। नागकन्येव निःश्वस्य दीर्घमुष्णं च भामिनी॥ मुहूर्ते चिन्तयामास मार्गमात्मसुखावहम्।
en: And gradually told everything to Mantharā. And having made up her mind, that lady wrought up with ire, being under the influence of Manthara's words, sighed hot and hard like the daughter of a Nāga, and for a while reflected on the way which was to bring her happiness.

sa: तथा हि राम वनवासनिश्चितं ददर्श देवी परमेण चेतसा। उवाच रामं शुभलक्षणं वचो बभूव च स्वस्त्ययनाभिकाशिणी॥
en: With great earnestness, the worshipful one began to eye Rāma, determined to go as an exile to the forest and spoke to his auspicious words and became desirous of performing benedictory ceremonies.

sa: यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यते ध्रुवं प्रणष्टो भरतो भविष्यति। अतो हि संचिन्तय राज्यमात्मजे परस्य चैवास्य विवासकारणम्॥
en: And when Rāma will obtain the earth, Bharata will certainly meet with destruction, therefore do you ponder as to how you can place your son on the throne and banish your enemy.

sa: स तस्य वाक्यं मधुरं निशम्य प्रणम्य तस्मै प्रयतो नृपेन्द्रः। जगाम हर्ष परमं महात्मा तमृष्यशृङ्ग पुनरप्युवाच॥
en: Hearing these sweet words of his, that foremost of monarchs bended low to him with controlled faculties, and experienced the excess of joy. And then that high-souled one again spoke to Rşyaśțnga.

sa: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महार्णवे। समेत्य तु व्यपेयातां कालमासाद्य कंचन॥ एवं भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च ज्ञातयश्च वसूनि च। समेत्य व्यवधावन्ति ध्रुवो ह्येषां विनाभवः॥
en: As on the mighty ocean, one piece of wood comes in contact with another; so, a person, having been in association with another, is separated from him in time. In this way, wives and sons and kindred and wealth, having been in association, go away; their separation is certain.

sa: हरामि वीर्याद् दुःखं ते तमः सूर्य इवोदितः। देवी पश्यतु मे वीर्यं राघवश्चैव पश्यतु॥ हनिष्ये पितरं वृद्धं कैकेय्यासक्तमानसम्। कृपणं च स्थितं बाल्ये वृद्धभावेन गर्हितम्॥
en: Like to the sun dispelling darkness, shall I remove your sorrow by dint of my power; may your worshipful self and Rāghava witness it. Readily shall I despatch my father, whose heart is unduly attached to Kaikeyſ and who is therefore vile and being old contemptibly playing the child.

sa: एतानीह नगस्यास्य शिलासंकटशालिनः॥ शिखराणि महेन्द्रस्य स्थिराणि च महान्ति च। येषु वेगं गमिष्यामि महेन्द्रशिखरेष्वहम्॥ नानादुमविकीर्णेषु धातुनिष्पन्दशोभिषु।
en: Here are these summits, firm and spacious, of this mountain, Mahendra, thronged with crags. I shall rush forward from these summits of Mahendra, interspersed with trees and adorned with masses of ore.

sa: तामसं नरशार्दूल सौमनं च महाबलम्। संवर्तं चैव दुर्धर्षं मौसलं च नृपात्मज ॥ सत्यमस्त्रं महाबाहो तथा मायामयं परम्। सौरं तेज:प्रभं नाम परतेजोऽपकर्षणम्॥ सोमास्त्रं शिशिरं नाम त्वाष्ट्रमस्त्रं सुदारुणम्। दारुणं च भगस्यापि शीलेषुमथ मानवम्॥
en: You, O mighty-armed Rāma, speedily accept the Tamasa, O tiger among men, and the exceedingly powerful Saumana, and the irrepressible Saſvarta and Mausala, O son of the king, and the Satya weapon, and the supreme Māyāmaya, and the Saura. Tejaprabha, capable of depriving foes of energy, and the Soma, and the ſisira, and the Tvāştra, and the terrible Daruna belonging to Bhaga, and Silesu, and Manava.

sa: अशुभान्येव भूयिष्ठं यथा प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे॥ अपि लक्ष्मण सीतायाः सामग्र्यं प्राप्नुयामहे। जीवन्त्याः पुरुषव्याघ्र सुताया जनकस्य वै॥
en: And, considering the many omens that take place before me, O Laksmana, I do not know whether we shall light upon welfare of Janaka's daughter Sita being alive, O best of men.

sa: ततोऽपरैरवार्यन्त गन्धर्वैः कुरुसैनिकाः। ते वार्यमाणा गन्धर्वैः साम्नैव वसुधाधिप॥ ताननादृत्य गन्धर्वांस्तद् वनं विविशुर्महत्। यदा वाचा न तिष्ठन्ति धार्तराष्ट्राः सराजकाः॥ ततस्ते खेचराः सर्वे चित्रसेने न्यवेदयन्।
en: O ruler of earth, the Gandharvas, again forbade the Kuru soldiers to advance. Though gently forbidden by the Gandharvas, disregarding all those Gandharvas, they entered that great forest. When the son of Dhritarashtra did not stop his soldiers, then those rangers of the sky went and spoke to Chitrasena.

sa: क हि शक्यं मया कर्तुं यद् वृद्धानां त्वया नृप। पुरा कथयतां नूनं न श्रुतं धर्मवादिनाम्॥
en: O king, what am I capable of doing (giving you good advice) when you have never before heard any thing from the virtuous men who are learned in the precepts of virtue?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच निकृतिर्देवनं पापं न क्षात्रोऽत्र पराक्रमः। न च नीति_वा राजन् किं त्वं द्यूतं प्रशंससि॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, deceitful gambling is a sin. there is no Kshatriya prowess (to be found) in it. There is certainly no moraliiy in it; why then are you praising gambling?

sa: आसनानि महार्हाणि यानानि शयनानि च। मणिकाञ्चनचित्राणि गजदन्तमयानि च॥ कवचानि विचित्राणि शस्त्राणि विविधानि च। रथांश्च विविधाकाराञ्जातरूपपरिष्कृतान्॥
en: Costly carpets, vehicles and beds, armours of various colours, decked with jewels, gems and ivory, and also weapons of various kinds and cars of various shapes handsomely made and adorned with gold.

sa: दुपदस्य कुले जातां स्नुषां पाण्डोर्महात्मनः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नस्य भगिनीं वीरपत्नीमनुव्रताम्। मां वै वनगतां दृष्ट्वा कस्मात् क्षमसि पार्थिव॥
en: Beholding me in the forest born in the race of Drupada, the daughter-in-law of the great Pandu, sister of Dhristadyumna, the devoted spouse of a heroes, do you forgive them, O king?

sa: येधर्ममेव प्रथमं चरन्ति धर्मेण लब्वा चधनानि काले। न चापि दारानवाप्य क्रतुभिर्यजन्ते तेषामयं चैव परश्च लोकः॥
en: Those that first lead a virtuous life and honestly acquire wealth in due time and then marry and perform sacrificial rites, attain happiness both in this world and in that to come.

sa: क्षीरं पिबन्तस्तिष्ठन्ति भुञ्जानाः शालितण्डुलान्। षष्टिस्तानि सहस्राणि सर्वे विपुलवक्षसः। एतद् राजन् मम धनं तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया।॥
en: And who drink milk and eat good rice. They are sixty thousands in number, and all of them possess broad cheats. With this wealth, O king, I shall (now stake with you.

sa: स्त्र्युवाच क्षन्तुमर्हसि मे विद्वन् भर्ता मे दैवतं महत्। स चाप क्षुधितः श्रान्तः प्राप्तः शुश्रूषितो मया॥
en: The Woman said : O learned one, it behoves you to grant me forgiveness. My husband is my chief god. He was very hunger and fatigued. Finding him thus, I served him.

sa: स तानि तीर्थानि च सागरस्य पुण्यानि चान्यानि बहूनि राजन्। क्रमेण गच्छन् परिपूर्णकाम: शूर्पारकं पुण्यतमं ददर्श॥
en: O king, he then went one after the other to all the Tirthas and also to other sacred places and thus his desires were fulfilled. He then saw the very sacred Shurparaka.

sa: पाण्डवाश्चोचुः साधु शोभनं भवता कृतं राजानमिन्द्रद्युम्नं स्वर्गलोकाच्च्युतं स्वे स्थाने प्रतिपादयतेत्यथैतानब्रवीदसौ ननु देवकीपुत्रेणापि कृष्णेन कृष्णेन नरके मज्जामानो राजर्षिर्तृगस्तस्मात् कृच्छ्रात् पुनः समुद्धृत्य स्वर्ग प्रापित इति॥
en: The Pandavas said : O blessed one, you acted properly in causing king Indradhyumna who had fallen from heaven to regain it. He (Markandeya) said, “The son of Devaki Krishna also had thus rescued the royal sage Nriga who had fallen into hell. He caused him to regain heaven.

sa: ततो गच्छेत ब्रह्मौतमस्य वनं प्रियम्॥ अहल्याया ह्रदे स्नात्वा व्रजेत परमां गतिम्। अभिगम्याश्रमं राजन् विन्दते श्रियमात्मनः॥
en: Then one should go to the charming forest of the Brahmarshi Gautama. Bathing in the lake Ahalya one attains to most excellent state; attaining to Sree, O king, one obtains best prosperity.

sa: वैश्या इव महीपाला द्विजातिपरिवेषकाः। न सा श्रीर्देवराजस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च। गुह्यकाधिपतेर्वापि या श्री राजन् युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: Like the Vaishyas the kings became the distributors of food to the Brahmanas. Such wealth does not belong even to the king of the celestials (Indra) or to Yama or to Varuna,

sa: श्रुत्वा च तान् पार्थिवपुत्रपौत्रान्। प्राप्तान् सुबाहुर्विषये समग्रान्। प्रत्युद्ययौ प्रीतियुतः स राजा तं चाभ्यनन्दन वृषभाः कुरूणाम्॥
en: Hearing of the arrival of those sons and grandsons of kings in his capital, King Subahu, full of joy, advanced to welcome them. And thosc best of the Kurus also greeted him.

sa: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च महारथौ तौ सुतैर्वृतं चाप्यथ सोमदत्तम्। सर्वाणि सन्यानि च वासुदेवः प्रधक्ष्यते सायकवह्निजालैः॥
en: The son of Vasudeva will consume by the shower of his fiery weapons all the soldiers together with those two great car-warriors, Bhishma and Drona and also Somadatta surrounded by his sons.

sa: दक्षिणां वै दिशं सर्वां प्लावयन्ती च मातृवत्। पूर्वं शम्भोर्जटाभ्रष्टा समुद्रमहिषी प्रिया। अस्यां नद्यां सुपुण्यायां यथेष्टमवगाह्यताम्॥
en: Issuing first from the matted locks of Sambhu (Shiva), this favourite queen of the ocean floods the southern country, (thereby benefiting it) as a mother. Bathe freely in this highly sacred river.

sa: त्यजेत सर्वां पृथिवीं समृद्धां युधिष्ठिरो धर्ममथो न जह्यात्। उक्तं जितोऽस्मीति च पाण्डवेन तस्मान्न शक्नोमि विवेक्तुमेतत्॥
en: Yudhishthira can abandon the whole world full of wealth, but he will never sacrifice morality. The Pandavas (Yudhisthira) himself has said, "I am won'. Therefore, I am unable to decide this matter.

sa: मा कुलस्य क्षये घोरे कारणं त्वं भविष्यसि। बद्धं सेतुं को नु भिन्द्याद् धमेच्छान्तं च पावकम्॥
en: Do not be the cause of the fearful destruction of this race. Who is there that will break an embankment which has been completed or re-kindle a conflagration which has been extinguished?

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजा प्रातिष्ठत भगीरथः। यत्र तानि शरीराणि सागराणां महात्मनाम्॥ प्लावनार्थं नरश्रेष्ठ पुण्येन सलिलेन च।
en: Having heard those words, the king Bhagiratha went to the place where lay the bodies of the illustrious sons of Sagara. So that (the place) might be flooded by her holy water.

sa: सात्यकिं समरे यान्तं तव पुत्रो न्यवारयत्॥ अभिमन्यु महाराज यान्तं भीष्मरथं प्रति। सुदक्षिणो महाराज काम्बोजः प्रत्यवारयत्॥ विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ समेतावरिमर्दनौ। अश्वत्थामा ततः क्रुद्धो वारयामास भारत।॥ तथा पाण्डुसुतं ज्येष्ठं भीष्मस्य वधकाक्षिणम्। भारद्वाजो रणे यत्तो धर्मपुत्रमवारयत्॥ अर्जुनं रभसं युद्धे पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। भीष्मप्रेप्सुं महाराज भासयन्तं दिशो दश॥ दुःशासनो महेष्वासो वारयामास संयुगे।
en: Your son (Duryodhana) resisted Satyaki proceeding to battle. Sudakshina, the ruler of the Kamvojas, checked, O king, Abhimanyu as he was rushing against the car of Bhishma. Ashvathama inflamed with wrath, O Bharata, checked the two aged warriors, those crushers of foes, Virata and Drupada. Then the son of Bharadvaja carefully, fighting checked the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira), as he was proceeding desirous of slaying Bhishma. Then, O king, the fierce bow-man Dushasana checked in battle, Arjuna himself, who desirous of reaching near Bhishma was advancing, placing Shikhandin before him, and illumining the ten points of the compass.

sa: भीष्म उवाच राजन् किमत्र साह्यं ते करोमि कुरुनन्दन। कामं योत्स्ये परस्यार्थे ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्॥
en: Bhishma said O king, O descendant of Kuru, what can I do for you. I shall of course fight on behalf of your enemies. Tell me what can I do for you?

sa: यां योगिनो ध्यानविविक्तदर्शनाः प्रयान्ति यां चोत्तमयज्विनो जनाः। तपोभिरिद्धैरनुयान्ति यां तथा तामक्षया ते तनयो गतो गतिम्॥
en: Your son has ascended to those regions, the eternal goal of Yogins who contemplate with their eyes shut or by performers of illustrious sacrifices or by people possessed of great ascetic merit.

sa: हताश्वसूतात् स रथादवप्लुत्य महाबलः॥ अमर्षवशमापन्नो व्याकुलः समपद्यत। विरथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठं श्वेतं दृष्ट्वा पितामहः॥ ताडयामास निशितैः शरसंधैः समन्ततः। स ताड्यमानः समरे भीष्मचापच्युतैः शरैः॥ स्वरथे धनुरुत्सृज्य शक्तिं जग्राह काञ्चनीम्। ततः शक्तिं रणे श्वेतो जग्राहोचां महाभयाम्॥ कालदण्डोपमां घोरां मृत्योर्जिह्वामिव श्वसन्। अब्रवीच्च तदा श्वेतो भीष्मं शान्तनवं रणे॥ तिष्ठेदानीं सुसंरब्धः पश्य मां पुरुषो भव। एवमुक्त्वा महेष्वासो भीष्मं युधि पराक्रमी॥ ततः शक्तिममेयात्मा चिक्षेप भुजगोपमाम्। पाण्डवार्थ प
en: Thereupon that great car-warrior jumped down from his car the horses and the charioteer of which had been killed. Seeing Shveta, that foremost of car-warriors, deprived of his car, the grandsire began to strike him on all sides with showers of arrows. Wounded in this great battle with arrows shot from Bhishma's bow, leaving his bow on his car, he took up a dart decked with gold, and taking up that terrible and fearful dart which resembled the fatal rod of Death and which was capable of killing even Death himself, Shveta thus spoke in anger to the son of Shantanu, Bhishma. "O foremost of men, wait a little and see my prowess". Having said this to Bhishma that greatly powerful and high-souled bow-man hurled that dart resembling a snake.

sa: स हि संग्रामशोभी च भक्तश्चापि किरीटिनः। चेकितानः सत्यधृति पाण्डवानां महारथौ। द्वाविमौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ रथोदारौ मतौ मम॥
en: He is an ornament in battle and an admirer of Arjuna. Chekitana and Satyadhriti are two Maharathies, among the Pandavas and these two foremost of men are mighty car-warriors in my opinion.

sa: स हि स्त्रीपूर्वको राजन् शिखण्डी यदि ते कन्या भूत्वा पुमान् जातो न योत्स्ये तेन भारत।॥
en: That Shikhandin, Oking, has formerly been a woman, perhaps you have heard of it; being originally a female he afterwards became a male and I shall not fight with him, O Bharata.

sa: उभयोः सेनयोः शूरा न्यकृन्तन्त परस्परम्। वर्तमाने तथा घोरे तस्मिन् युद्धे सुदारुणे। द्रोणपाञ्चाल्ययो राजन् महानासीत् समागमः॥
en: So long that fearful battle continued, heroic warriors of both sides cut one another down. O king, the battle that was fought between Drona and the Panchala prince was also very fearful.

sa: भीष्म उवाच न स्म तं तात पश्यामि समरे यो जयेत माम्। न तावन्मृत्युकालोऽपि पुनरागमनं कुरु॥
en: Bhishma said O sire, I do not find the man who can defeat me in battle. The time for my death is not yet come. (On some future occasion) come to me.

sa: पट्टिशं च त्रिभिर्बाणैचिच्छेद तिलकाण्डवत्॥ स बिभेद शतघ्नीं च नवभिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। मद्रराजप्रयुक्तं च शरं छित्त्वा महारथः॥
en: He also served that battle-axe as if it were sesame stalk with three arrows; he broke into pieces the Shataghni with nine shafts furnished with wings of the feathers of Kanka birds.

sa: द्रौपदेयान् महेष्वासानभिमन्युं च पाण्डवः। नकुलं सहदेवं च सर्वाश्चैव प्रभद्रकान्॥ दश चाश्वसहस्राणि द्विसहस्राणि दन्तिनाम्। अयुतं च पदातीनां रथाः पञ्चशतं तथा॥ भीमसेनस्य दुर्धर्ष प्रथमं प्रादिशद् बलम्। मध्यमे च विराटं च जयत्सेनं च पाण्डवः॥
en: And the son of Pandu ordered the five sons of Draupadi who were mighty bowmen, and Abhimanyu Nakula and Sahadeva, and all the Prabhadraka, and ten thousand horses and elephants; and ten thousand foot-soldiers, and five hundred chariots, to be the first division of the ariny, under the irresistible Bhimasena. And the son of Pandu (ordered) in the middle (division of his army) Virata and Jayatsena,

sa: अहो घिङ् निहतो भीमः कुञ्जरेणेति मारिष। तेन नागेन संत्रस्ता पाण्डवानामनीकिनी॥ सहसाभ्यद्रवद् राजन् यत्र तस्थौ वृकोदरः।
en: 'Alas, Bhima is slain by the elephant' was set up by all the troops, O sire. Frightened by that elephant, the Pandava army suddenly fled, O king, there where Vrikodara was standing.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच क्षत्रियाणां बलं तेजो ब्राह्मणानां क्षमा बलम्। क्षमा मां भजते यस्माद् गम्यतां यदि रोचते॥
en: Vasishtha said : The might of the Kshatriyas lies in their physical strength, that of the Brahmanas lies in their forgiveness. I cannot give up forgiveness. If you like, you can go.

sa: अजमीढस्य चतुर्विशं पुत्रशतं बभूव कैकेय्यां गान्धार्यां विशालायामृक्षायां चेति। पृथक् पृथग् वंशधरा नृपतयः। तत्र वंशकरः संवरणः॥
en: Ajamidha had four wives, namely Kaikeyi, Gandhari, Vishala and Riksha and he begot on them two thousands and one hundred sons. And Amongst them all, Samvarana became the perpetuator of the dynasty,

sa: द्रुपद उवाच त्वं च कुन्ती च कौन्तेय धृष्टद्युम्नश्च मे सुतः। कथयन्त्विति कर्तव्यं श्वः काले करवामहे॥
en: Drupada said : O son of Kunti, my son Dhrishtaduymna, Kunti and you yourself, these three settle amongst yourselves as to what should be done. I shall do what is proper tomorrow.

sa: सा तेन शापेन जगाम भूमि तदोर्वशी चारुदती सुनेत्रा। बहूनि वर्षाण्यवसच्च सुभ्रूः शापक्षयादिन्द्रसदो ययौ च ॥
en: In this wise Urvasi, having beautiful teeth, eyes and brow, remained on earth for many years and then returned to the region of Indra after the period of curse had been over.

sa: अस्य रूपं च सत्त्वं च बलमूर्जितमेव च। एष श्रिया समुदितः पुत्रस्तव न संशयः॥ प्रापयिष्यति तत् सर्वं विक्रमेण समन्वितः। अस्य वीर्यवतो वीर्यं नानुयास्यन्ति पार्थिवाः॥
en: (Hear also) what will be his beauty, excellence, strength and courage. There is not the least doubt that your this son will grow in prosperity and will obtain them, endued as he is with great prowess. No king will be able to equal your greatly powerful son in prowess,

sa: ततोऽन्यं घृतकुम्भं च समानाय्य महातपाः। तं चापि प्राक्षिपत् तत्र कन्यामागं तपोधनः॥ एतत् ते कथितं राजन् दुःशलाजन्म भारत। ब्रूहि राजेन्द्र किं भूयो वर्तयिष्यामि तेऽनघ।॥
en: Then that great ascetic, bringing another jar filled with ghee, placed the part into it for the purpose of daughter, O descendant of the Bharata race, thus have I narrated to you all about the birth of Dushala. O sinless one, tell me what more am I to narrate.

sa: ऋतावृतौ राजपुत्रि स्त्रिया भर्ता पतिव्रते॥ नातिवर्तव्य इत्येवं धर्मं धर्मविदो विदुः। शेषष्वन्येषु कालेषु स्वातन्त्र्यं स्त्री किलार्हति॥
en: O princess, O devoted wife, the men learned in the precepts of virtue, said that a wife in her season must seek her husband, though she may be free at other times.

sa: यमस्य यज्ञो हरिमेधसश्च यथा यज्ञो रन्तिदेवस्य राज्ञः। तथा यज्ञोऽयं तव भारताग्र्य पारिक्षित स्वस्ति नोऽस्तु प्रियेभ्यः॥
en: O son of Parikshit, O best of the Bharata race, your this sacrifice is like the sacrifices of Yama, Harimedha and king Rantideva. Blessings be upon those who are dear to us!

sa: तेषां संवदतां तत्र श्रोतृणां हर्षवर्धनम्। गेयं प्रचक्रतुस्तत्र तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ॥ ततः प्रवृत्तं मधुरं गान्धर्वमतिमानुषम्। न च तृप्तिं ययुः सर्वे :श्रोतारो गेयसंपदा॥ हृष्टा मुनिगणाः सर्वे पार्थिवाश्च महौजसः। पिबन्त इव चक्षुभिः पश्यन्ति स्म मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: The audience being seated there and engaged in conversation with one another those two Muni boys began with the song enhancing the delight of all. Wondrous and charming was their song and the audience were not by any means satiated with the hearing thereof. Greatly delighted the highly effulgent ascetics and kings again and again looked towards them as if drinking them up with their eyes.

sa: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये। बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी॥
en: Sattva Intellect, O Partha, is that which knows action and inaction, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, and which knows fear and fearfulness, bondage and deliverance.

sa: तेषां महेन्द्रोपमविक्रमाणां संरब्धानां धर्षणाद् याज्ञसेन्याः। क्रोधः प्रजज्वाल जयद्रथं च दृष्ट्वा प्रियां तस्य रथे स्थितां च॥
en: Endued with the strength of Indra, they had grown furious at the insult offered to Draupadi; but their anger was inflamed (the more) seeing Jayadratha and their sweet heart-seated in his car.

sa: जम्वुक उवाच शृणु मे त्वं महाबाहो यद् वाक्यं मूषिकोऽब्रवीत्। धिग् बलं पृगराजस्य मयाद्यायं मृगो हतः॥
en: The Jackal said: O mighty armed one, hear what the mouse has said. (He said)" Fie on the strength of the king of beasts (tiger). The deer has been killed by me.

sa: ततो राजन् पार्थिवाः सर्व एव वैश्या इवास्मानुपतिष्ठन्तु सद्यः। दुर्योधनः शकुनिः सूतपुत्रः प्रीत्या राजन् पाण्डुपुत्रान् भजन्तु॥
en: O king, all the monarchs of the world then like Vaisyas will pay homage to us. O king, let Duryodhana, Shakuni and Suta's son (Karna) gladly wait upon the sons of Pandu.

sa: भज्यमानेषु सर्वेषु कुरुराजो विशाम्पते। परेषामात्मनश्चैव सैन्ये ते समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: When his army was thus broken, the Kuru king, O monarch, rushed against both friends and foes.

sa: आधूतां भीमसेनेन गदां दृष्ट्वा सुयोधनः॥ अद्रिसारमयीं गुर्वीमाविध्यन् बहशोभता
en: Seeing Bhimasena whirling his mace, Suyodhana also whirled his heavy and adamantine mace, and appeared highly beautiful.

sa: रावणं निहतं दृष्ट्वा राघवेण महात्मना। अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतू राक्षस्यः शोककर्शिताः॥
en: Beholding Rävaņa Slain by the high-souled Rāghava Räksasaees, stricken with grief, issued out of the inner appartments.

sa: अन्तमद्य गमिष्यामि तस्य दुःखस्य पार्षतः॥ हन्तास्यद्य रणे कर्णं स वा मां निहनिष्यति। संग्रामेण सुघोरेण सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I shall go today to the end of that misery, O son of Prishata. I shall either slay today in battle Karna or he will kill me with a dreadful encounter. I tell you the truth.

sa: प्रजङ्ग्रेन च संपातिनित्यं दुर्धर्षणो रणे। जम्बुमालिनामारब्धो हनूमानपि वानरः॥
en: Sampāti, hard to to bear, engaged with Prajangha; and the monkey, Hanumān, entered into conflict with Jambumālī.

sa: क्षत्रियाच महावीर्या भगदत्तपुरोगमाः। दिव्यास्त्रविदुषः शूराः क्षपयिष्यन्ति ते रिपून्।॥
en: Other greatly powerful Kshatriyas headed by Bhagadatta, all learned in the celestials weapons, will kill your enemies.

sa: वानराणामपि चमूवृंहति जयमिच्छताम्। अभ्यधावत तां सेनां रक्षसां घोरकर्मणाम्॥
en: The mighty monkey-army also, eager for victory, darted against the host of the Rākşasa of dreadful deeds.

sa: धर्मे दृढत्वं युधि शत्रुघातं यशस्तथाग्र्यं परमं बलं च। योगप्रियत्वं तव संनिकर्ष वृणे सुतानां च शतं शतानि॥
en: I ask for these boons from you, namely firmness in virtue, the destruction of enemies in battle, the highest glory, the greatest power, devotion to Yoga, your nearness, and hundreds upon hundreds of children.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा व्यासः सत्यवतीं तदा। शयने सा च कौसल्या शुचिवस्त्रा ह्यलंकृता॥ समागमनमाका दिति सोऽन्तर्हितो मुनिः। ततोऽभिगम्य सा देवी स्नुषां रहसि संगताम्॥ धर्म्यमर्थसपायुक्तमुवाच वचनं हितम्। कौसल्ये धर्मतन्त्रं त्वां यद् ब्रवीमि निबोध तत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus spoken to Satyavati, the greatly effulgent Vyasa said to her, “Let the princess of Kosalya adorned with ornaments wait for me in her bed room in clear attire. (so saying) he (immediately) disappeared. Satyavati then went to her daughter-in-law and in private, spoke to her these words of beneficial and virtuous import, “O princess of Kosalya, hear what I say. It is consistent with virtue.

sa: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु भरतो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। अहमेनं वधिष्यामि ममांशः स विधीयताम्।।
en: Thus addressed by Raghava Bharata remarked: "I will slay this. Let this task be entrusted to me."

sa: भीमेन कार्तवीर्येण वैन्येन नहुषेण च। तपोयोगसमाधिस्थैरुद्धता ह्यापदः प्रजाः॥
en: Dhaumya, Kartavirya, Vainya and Nahusha all protected their subjects from dangers by virtue.of ascetic meditation and vows.

sa: ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां तदन्नममृतोपमम्। दिव्यानुद्वीक्ष्य भक्ष्यांस्तानभवद् भक्षणे मतिः॥
en: And beholding the inviting viands resembling ambrosia, they although already fed, became desirous of eating once again.

sa: तथा लोभाभिभूताश्च भविष्यन्ति नरा नृप। ब्राह्मणांश्च हनिष्यन्ति ब्राह्मणस्वोपभोगिनः॥
en: O king, led away by covetousness, men will kill the Brahmanas and appropriate and enjoy their wealth.

sa: प्रविश्याभ्यन्तरं श्रीमान् दैवतान्यभिगम्य च। पूजयामास रत्नैश्च गन्धमाल्यैश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Entering the palace, Yudhishthira approached the tutelary deities and adored them with gems and scents and garlands.

sa: तमस्य चिच्छेद शरं शिखण्डी त्रिभिस्त्रिभिश्च प्रतुतोद् कर्णम्। शिखण्डिनः कार्मुकं च ध्वजं च छित्त्वा क्षुगभ्यां न्यपतत् सुजातः॥
en: as But Shikhandin severed that arrow with three shafts and with three other distressed Karna; then the wrathful son of Suta with two razor-like shafts struck off the bows, arrows and banners of Shikhandi.

sa: तासामाक्रन्दशब्देन सहसोद्गतचेतने। कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च त्यक्तनिद्रे बभूवतुः॥
en: At the sounds of their lamentations, both Kausalya and Sumitrā suddenly regaining consciousness, awoke from their sleep.

sa: संचोदितो रथः शीघ्रं खरस्य रिपुघातिनः। शब्देनापूरयामास दिशः सप्रदिशस्तथा॥
en: And driven with speed, the car of Khara. slayer of foes, filled all directions with its rattle.

sa: इत्येवं सम्प्रवर्तन्ते व्यवहाराः पुरातनाः। ऋषीणामितरेषां च साधु चैतदसंशयम्॥
en: Such is the old practice followed by the Rishis and others. Forsooth, this is righteous.' Yudhishthira said

sa: अद्यैतद् वै विदितं पार्थिवानां भविष्यति ह्याकुमारं च सूत। निमग्नो वा समरे भीमसेन एकः कुरून् वा समरे व्यजैषीत्॥
en: Today, O Suta, it will be known to all the Kshatriyas, even unto the last generation, that either Bhimasena has given himself up in battle, or, singly, he has got the better of all the Kurus.

sa: अमी मयूराः शोभन्ते प्रनृत्यन्तस्ततस्ततः॥ स्वैः पक्षैः पवनोद्भूतैर्गवाक्षैः स्फाटिकैरिव।
en: These peacocks and pea-hens unfurling then wings like to crystal lattices, have been dancing hither and thither.

sa: अदृश्यमाना वैदेही शोकं वर्धयतीह मे॥ दृश्यमानो वसन्तश्च स्वेदसंसर्गदूषकः।
en: Sītä, away from my vision and the spring, drying up perspiration, have been both inciting my amour.

sa: एवं कृत्वा स भगवांस्ततोऽन्यद् रूपमास्थितः। दिव्यमेव महाराज वसानोऽद्भुतमम्बरम्॥
en: That divine being, having done this great king, appeared in another divine form, wearing a wonderful garment.

sa: ततो ध्वजमुपागम्य हेमदण्डं समुच्छ्रितम्। समाक्रम्य महाकायस्तस्थौ गृध्रः सुदारुणः॥
en: And a frightful vulture, having a huge body, approaching the banner, sat upon the upraised golden flag-staff.

sa: एवमाश्वास्य वैदहीं हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः। गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीमभ्यवादयत्॥
en: Having thus consoled Vaidehi's daughter, Hanumān, son to the Wind-god, setting his heart upon departure, saluted Vaidehi.

sa: देवैरसुरसंड्बैश्च मथ्यतां कलशोदधिः। भविष्यत्यमृतं तत्र मथ्यमाने महोदधौ॥ सर्वोषधी: समावाप्य सर्वरत्नानि चैव ह। मन्यध्वमुदधिं देवा वेत्स्यध्वममृतं ततः॥
en: "Churn the ocean with both the Devas and the Asuras. By doing so, the Ambrosia and all drugs and gems will be obtained. O celestials, churn the ocean and you will get the Ambrosia.

sa: महाकपालः स्थूलाक्षः प्रमाथस्त्रिशिरास्तथा। चत्वार एते सेनाने दूषणं पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः॥
en: And Mahākapāla, Sthūlākṣa, Pramātha and Trisirā—These four going before the forces, went at the back of Dūşaņa.

sa: श्यामं रुधिरपर्यन्तं बभूव परिवेषणम्। अलातचक्रप्रतिम प्रतिगृह्य दिवाकरम् ॥
en: A dark circle bordered with red, resembling that of charcoal, appeared in the vicinity of the sun.

sa: सोऽहं शासनमाज्ञाय धनदस्य महात्मनः। त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्तो निर्विशङ्कः प्रतीच्छ माम्॥
en: Hearing this command of the high-souled Kubera I have come to you. Do you fearlessly accept me..

sa: ततो द्रोणं महेष्वासः सत्यजित् सत्यविक्रमः। अविध्यन्निशिताग्रेण परमास्त्रं विदर्शयन्॥
en: Then the mighty warrior Satyajit of prowess invincible, displaying excellent weapons, pierced Drona with a keen-pointed shaft.

sa: एवमस्त्विति रामेण पूजयित्वा विसर्जितम्॥ अभिप्रेतां दिशं तस्मात्प्रायात्तत्पुष्पकं तदा।
en: Having been adored by Rāma and saying ‘so be it' Pușpaka L.oceeded towards its wished for direction.

sa: तथैव भीमसेनोऽपि धृतराष्ट्र जनाधिपम्। नामर्षयत राजेन्द्र सदैव दुष्टवद्धदा॥
en: Bhiimasena also, O king, moved by a wicked heart, was unable to put up with king Dhritarashtra.

sa: विरूपो यावदादर्श नात्मनः पश्यते मुखम्। मन्यते तावदात्मानमन्येभ्यो रूपवत्तरम्॥
en: The ugly man, until he sees his face in a mirror, considers himself more handsome than others.

sa: श्येनवद् व्यचरद् भीमः खड्डेन गदया तथा॥ पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्रास्तावकानां व्यपोथयत्।
en: Armed with sword and mace, Bhima inoved on like a hawk and killed your twenty-five thousand warriors.

sa: तेनैव च मुहूर्तेन दिव्याभरणभूषिताः। आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा ब्राह्मणा प्रहिताः स्त्रियः।॥
en: And at that very moment there came twenty thousand women commissioned by Brahma, adorned with divine ornaments.

sa: भव एधस्व मोदस्व धनैस्तर्पय च द्विजान्। एतत् ते विस्तरेणोक्तं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। आपृच्छे त्वां गमिष्यामि दाशार्हनगरी प्रति॥
en: Grow in prosperity, enjoy felicity gratify the Brahmans with wealth. I have thus answered in detail all that you have asked me. With your permission, I shall now go towards the city of the Dasharahas (Dwarka).

sa: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टः सुषेणो हरिपुंगवः। शिलां सुमहतीं गृह्य निशाचरमभिद्रवत्॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of monkeys, Sușeņa, growing furious, taking up a gigantic crag, rushed at the night-ranger.

sa: ऋषभः शरभो नीलो गवाक्षो गन्धमादनः। पञ्च वानरशार्दूलाः कुम्भकर्णमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Then Rşabha and Sarabha and Nīla and Gavākṣa and Gandhamādana, these five terrific monkeys, rushed against Kumbhakarņa.

sa: विफलं कर्म च कृतं भवेत् तुष्टिर्न तस्य च॥ वृथा च दर्शितं वीर्यं भवेद् वानरपुङ्गवाः। तस्माद् गच्छाम वै सर्वे यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः। सुग्रीवश्च महातेजाः कार्यस्यास्य निवेदने॥
en: What is the use of undertaking this work for nothing which shall not conduce to his pleasure? And useless shall be the display of your prowess, O you, foremost of the monkeys. Let us therefore proceed where Rāma, with Laksmana, and the highly effulgent Sugrīva is, and relate to them our proposed work.

sa: प्रस्तरेषु च रम्येषु विविधाः काननद्रुमाः। वायुवेगप्रचलिताः पुष्पैरवकिरन्ति गाम्॥
en: Various trees growing on rock surfaces, moved by the wind have been scattering flowers on the earth.

sa: अथाब्रवीत् पुनर्वाक्यं धृतराष्ट्रो युधिष्ठिरम्। अनुजानीहि मां राजस्तापस्ये भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then Dhritarashtra, once more addressing Yudhishthira, said these words-Do you, O king, permit me to practice penance's.

sa: इह तस्मात् प्रजाहेतोः प्रजायन्ते नरोत्तमाः। यथैवाहं पितुः क्षेत्रे जातस्तेन महर्षिणा॥ तथैवास्मिन् मम क्षेत्रे कथं वै सम्भवेत् प्रजा।
en: The best of men were born to beget children to discharge that debt. As I was begotten by the great Rishi on the field of my father, so should children be begotten on my soil (wives).

sa: क्षत्रियस्य प्रमत्तस्य दोषः संजायते महान्। अधर्माः सम्प्रवर्धन्ते प्रजासंकरकारकाः॥
en: If a king acts heedlessly, it produces a great evil. Unrighteousness multiplies causing an intermixture of castes.

sa: स तीक्ष्णविषदिग्धेन शरेणातिवलात् क्षतः। उत्सृज्य फलपत्राणि पादपः शोषमागतः॥
en: The tree, pierced with that arrow covered with dreadful poison, withered away, shedding its leaves and fruits.

sa: न तेषामापदः सन्ति नाधयो व्याधयस्तथा। ये तवानन्यमनसः कुर्वन्त्यर्चनवन्दनम्॥
en: Those that adore and worship you with undivided attention are delivered from all dangers, agonies and afflictions.

sa: एवंगुणगणैर्युक्ता यस्य स्युः कार्यसाधकाः। तस्य सिद्ध्यन्ति सर्वेऽर्था दूतवाक्यप्रचोदिताः॥
en: Indeed whose emissaries are so accomplished, all his missions are fulfilled only by virtue of their words.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु सिद्धार्थवचो राजा श्रान्ततरस्वरः। शोकोपहतया वाचा कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Siddhārtha's words, the king, his voice waxing exceedingly feeble, addressed Kaikeyī in words surcharged with emotion.

sa: एवं विधानं लङ्कायां कृत्वा राक्षसपुंगवः। कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मन्यते कालचोदितः॥
en: Having taken these measures in Lankā, the raksasa-chief, urged by Fate, deemed himself as having achieved success.

sa: यस्मात्स कृतवान्पापमीदृशं घोरसंहितम्। तस्मात्प्राप्स्यति दुर्मेधाः फलं पापस्य कर्मणः॥
en: Since that vile being has perpetrated such a dreadful crime he shall forsooth suffer the consequence thereof.

sa: तं भीमो दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदजिह्मगैः। पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: In return, Bhima pierced him with ten straight-flying arrows and next with twenty arrows of depressed knots.

sa: इन्द्राशनिसमां घोरां यमदण्डमिवोद्यताम्॥ ददृशुस्ते महाराज भीमसेनस्य तां गदाम्।
en: People, O king, saw the mace of Bhimasena look as terrible as Indra's thunder-bolt or Yama's rod.

sa: आक्रोष्टा क्रुध्यते राजंस्तथा द्वेष्यत्वमाप्नुते॥ येन येन शरीरेण यद्यत् कर्म करोति यः। तेन तेन शरीरेण तत्तत् फलमुपाश्नुते॥
en: He who acts with hostility towards another becomes the victim of similar deeds done by that other. Whatever acts one does in whatever bodies, he has to suffer the consequences thereof in those bodies.

sa: आशीर्युक्तानि कर्माणि कुर्वते ये त्वतन्द्रिताः। अहंकारसमायुक्तास्ते सकाशे प्रजापतेः॥
en: Those who without idleness perforın deeds with expectation, being full of egoism, approach the presence of Prajapati.

sa: नैवात्मनोऽथ लघुतां जामदग्न्योऽध्यगच्छत। स तु क्रतुवरेणेष्वा महात्मा दक्षिणावता॥
en: Having, however, celebrated that foremost of sacrifices, the great Rama could not acquire perfect lightness of heart.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्रूहि तात कुरुश्रेष्ठ वर्णानां त्वं पृथक् पृथक। कीदृश्यां कीदृशाश्चापि पुत्राः कस्य च के च ते॥
en: Yudhishthira said Describe to us, O sire, the orders and classes separately, what kind of son is begotten on what women, who is entitled to have whom for sons, and what kinds of sons are there.

sa: कृताह्निकं च राजानं धृतराष्ट्रं महीपतिम्। ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं गान्धारीसहितं तदा॥
en: He saw king Dhritarashtra, seated at ease, with Gandhari besides him, after having finished his morning rites.

sa: धरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च सावित्रोऽथानिलोऽनलः॥ प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः।
en: Dhara, Dhruva, Soma, Savittra, Anila, Anala, Pratyusha, and Prabyhava, are the eight Vasus, named in the scriptures.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। देवक्याश्चैव संवादं महर्षेर्नारदस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is recited this ancient discourse between Devaki and Narada, that foremost of Rishis.

sa: पृथक् पृथक् च ते चैनं मानार्थाभ्यामयोजयन्। ततस्तृतीये दिवसे सत्यवत्यात्मजो मुनिः॥ युधिष्ठिरं समभ्येत्य वाग्मी वचनमब्रवीत्। अद्यप्रभृति कौन्तेय यजस्व समयो हि ते। मुहूर्तो यज्ञियः प्राप्तश्चोदयन्तीह याजकाः॥
en: On the third day, the sage Vyasa the son of Satyavati, that foremost of eloquent men, approaching Yudhishthira, said, From this day, O son of Kunti, do you begin your sacrifice. The time for it has come! The moment for undertaking the rite is at hand. The priests are urging you.

sa: इदं च मामब्रवीद् धर्मराजः पुनः पुनः सम्प्रहृष्टो महर्षे दानेन यः प्रयतोऽभूत् सदैव विशेषतो गोप्रदानं च कुर्यात्॥
en: And, O great Rishi, the righteous Yama, filled with joy, repeatedly told me. One who, by making repeated gifts, has succeeded in acquiring purity of mind should then make gift of kine in particular.

sa: षष्टिं शतसहस्राणि ब्राह्मणानां महौजसाम्। विधिवद् भोजयामास भोज्यं सर्वगुणान्वितम्॥
en: He duly fod six millions of Brahmanas, gifted with great energy, with edibles possessed of every recommendation.

sa: तदपत्यं हि युवयोर्देवानभिभवेद् ध्रुवम्। न हि ते पृथिवी देवी न च द्यौर्न दिवं विभो॥ नेदं धारयितुं शक्ताः समस्ता इति मे मतिः। तेज:प्रभावनिर्दग्धं तस्मात् सर्वमिदं जगत्॥
en: Your offspring will certainly be able of afflict the celestials. Neither the goddess Earth, nor the Sky, nor Heaven, O powerful one, nor all of them together, will be able to bear your energy, we firmly believe. The entire universe yours which is certain to be burnt through the force of your energy.

sa: शतं शतसहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥ मुमुचुः सैन्धवा राजस्तदा गाण्डीवधन्वनि।
en: The Saindhavas then, O king, shot hundreds and thousands of straight arrows at the wielder of Gandiva.

sa: ततस्तं ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा पुनरेव महायशाः। आजगाम महाप्राज्ञः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्तदा॥
en: Secing him changed into a Brahmana, the celebrated Rishi,viz.,. Krishna Dvaipayana of great wisdom came to him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु नरो लोभं विवर्जयेत्। एष धर्मः परो राजस्तस्पाल्लोभं विवर्जयेत्॥ इदं नरः सुचरितं समवायेषु कीर्तयन्। अर्थभागी च भवति न च दुर्गाण्यवाप्नुते॥ प्रीयन्ते पितरश्चास्य ऋषयो देवतास्तथा। यशोधर्मार्थभागी च भवति प्रेत्य मानवः॥
en: Therefore, a man should give up the lure. O king, is the highest duty. Cupidity should be renounced. The man who recites this account in assemblies of men, succeeds in acquiring riches. Such a man has never to come by a distressful end. The departed Manes, the Rishis, and the celestials become all pleased with him. Hereafter, again, he becomes gifted with fame and religions merit and riches.

sa: ऋषीणां देवतानां च वंशांस्तावाहतुः सदा। प्रीयमाणौ महात्मानौ पुराणावृषिसत्तमौ॥
en: And those two great ancient sages, pleased, recited the genealogy of the races of saints and gods.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच क्व नु सा ब्राह्मणी कृष्ण क्व चासौ ब्राह्मणर्पभः। याभ्यां सिद्धिरियं प्राप्ता तावुभौ वद मेऽच्युत॥
en: Arjuna said, Where, indeed, is that Brahmana's wife, O Krishna, and where is that foremost of Brahmanas, by both of whom was such success acquired. Tell me about them, O you of undecaying glory.

sa: तथा च तेषां सर्वेषां कथाभिर्नृपसंनिधौ। व्यासमन्वास्यतां राजन्नाजग्मुर्मुनयो परे॥
en: While all those princes sat around Vyasa, engaged in conversation on various topics, other Rishis came there.

sa: निहत्य रावणं संख्ये सर्वथा निशितैः शरैः। प्रतिनेष्यति रामस्त्वामयोध्यामसितेक्षणे॥
en: O dark-eyed lady slaying Rāvaņa in battle with sharp shafts, Rāma shall take the back to Ayodhyā.

sa: मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसंज्ञस्तु महापार्यो महाबलः। अङ्गदं बहुभिर्बाणैर्भूयस्तं प्रत्यविध्यत॥ जाम्बवन्तं त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे। ऋक्षराजं गवाक्षं च जघान बहुभिः शरैः॥ गवाक्षं जाम्बवन्तं च स दृष्ट्वा शरपीडितौ। जग्राह परिघं घोरमङ्गदः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: And regaining his senses in a moment the highly powerful Mahāpārsva, again assailed Angada with many arrows. He struck Jambavan, the lord of bears, on his breast with three-arrows and assailed Gavākṣa with many shafts. And beholding Jämbavān and Gavākṣa overwhelmed with arrows, Angada, beside himself with ire, took up a dreadful parigha.

sa: सा वेगिता बलवता रावणेन दुरात्मना। जज्वाल सुमहातेजा दीप्ताशनिसमप्रभा॥
en: On being whirled by the impious and strong Rāvana, the dart possessed of exceeding energy, flamed up

sa: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः॥
en: Being thus commanded, Hanumān, the son of Maruta, worshipped of the night-rangers, entered the city of Lanka.

sa: निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयः सैन्ये चास्य समन्ततः। दुर्विषह्यस्वरा घोरं विना जलधरोदयम्॥
en: On the Raksasa host on all sides dreadful lightnings were showered without the sound of the clouds.

sa: विभीषणस्य तु वचस्तच्छुत्वा रघुसत्तमः। अन्वीक्ष्य मनसा सर्वमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of Vibhīşana and weighing them in his mind, that foremost of Raghu's race said.

sa: स कृत्तमूलः सहसेव वृक्षः क्षितौ पपात क्षतजोक्षिताङ्गः। तां चास्य घोरां यमदण्डकल्पां गदां प्रगृह्याशु तदा ननाद। ५९।।
en: Thereat like a tree whose roots have been severed, he suddenly dropped on the ground, covered with blood. And thereupon, (Risabha) swiftly snatched his dreadful mace resembling the rod of Yama himself; and shouted.

sa: ततः कृष्णाजिनधरं कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम्। ददर्श स्वसुतं तत्र मेघनादं भयावहम्॥
en: He beheld his fearful son Meghanāda too, clad in an antelope skin and holding Sikhă and Kamandalu.

sa: तौ भासयन्तावाकाशं धनुभ्यां विशिखौ च्युतौ। मुखेन मुखमाहत्य संनिपेततुरोजसा॥
en: Those flaming arrows, discharged from the bows, illumining the welkin, with vehemence struck at each others head.

sa: उपरिष्टाद्धि नयनं स्फुरमाणमिमं मम। विजयं समनुप्राप्तं शंसतीव मनोरथम्।७।।
en: The upper lid of my eye throb; and it betook that my desire has indeed been had.

sa: तमभ्रघनसंकाशमापतन्त महाकपिम्। दृष्ट्वा ते वानराः सर्वे तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा॥
en: And seeing that mighty monkey resembling a mass of clouds, alighting, those monkeys stood joining their hands.

sa: ममानुरूपं तपसो बलं च ते पराक्रमश्चास्त्रबलं च संयुगे। न त्वां समासाद्य रणावम मनः श्रमं गच्छति निश्चितार्थम्॥
en: And your ascetic energy is like to mine, as well as your prowess and mighty in arms in battle. And having you in the conflict, my mind assured (of victory), dose not experience sorrow.

sa: यथा बलाहके विद्युत् पावको वा शिलोच्चये। तथा गाण्डीवमभवदिन्द्रायुधमिवानतम्॥
en: As lightning in the clouds, as fire in the rock, so the Gandiva shone like the rain-bow.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। चिन्तामापेदिरे सर्वे सकिंनरमहोरगाः॥
en: Thereupon the celestials with Gandharvas, Siddhas, great saints, Kinnaras and serpents, were all worked up with anxiety.

sa: स नेमिघोषेण महान्सहसाभिनिनादयन्॥ राजमार्ग श्रिया जुष्टं प्रतिपेदे महारथः।
en: That redoubtable and mighty car-warrior held his course, suddenly making sides resound, and beautifying the high ways.

sa: स शरैः सूर्यसंकाशैः शातकुम्भविभूषणैः। वानरान्समरे वीरः प्रममाथ सुदुर्जयः॥
en: That invincible hero in that conflict mangled the monkeys with shafts resembling the Sun, decked with gold.

sa: मौात्पूर्वं कृतो रोषस्तद् भवान् क्षन्तुमर्हति । यथैव हि पिता तेऽभूत् पूर्वं हरिगणेश्वरः॥ तथा त्वमपि सुग्रीवो नान्यस्तु हरिसत्तम।
en: It behove you to forgive us for our wrath arising out of ignorance. Like to your sire before, yourself and Sugrīva are the lords of these monkey hosts, O you foremost of them and none else.

sa: तासामेका ततः क्रुद्धा बालवद्गृह्य लीलया। भ्रामितस्तु सखीमध्ये मध्ये गृह्य दशाननम्॥ सखीमन्यां समाहूय पश्य त्वं कीटकं धृतम्। दशास्यं विंशतिभुजं कृष्णाञ्जनसमप्रभम्॥ हस्ताद्धस्तं स च क्षिप्तो भ्राम्यते भ्रमलालसः। भ्राम्यप्राणेन बलिना राक्षसेन विपश्चिता॥ पाणावेकाथ संदष्टा रोषेण वनिता शुभा। मुक्तस्तयाशुभ: कीटो धुन्वन्त्या हस्तवेदनात्॥ गृहीत्वान्या तु रक्षेन्द्रमुत्पपात विहायसा। ततस्तामपि संक्रुद्धो विददार नखै शम्॥ तया सह विनिर्वृतः सहसैव निशाचरः। पपात सोऽम्भसो मध्ये सागरस्य भयातुरः॥
en: But one of them, being enraged, took up Rāvana, like a child, as if in sport and hurled him among her companions. And addressing another she said: "Behold, I have caught this black Rāvaņa, having twenty arms and ten faces, like a small insect. Thereupon Rāvana, being worn out with hurling, passed from one hand to another. Being thus hurled the learned and powerful Rāvana, in anger, severely bit the palms of that fair one. Being overwhelmed with pain that damsel let him off. Thereupon, another, taking that Raksasachief, rose up in the welkin. Ravana, again waxing wroth tore her with his nails. And being left off by that damsel, the terrified night-ranger fell down into the waters of the deep.

sa: कर्तुमर्हसि रामस्य साहाय्यं विषये सती। अथवा मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम्॥ आगमिध्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते।
en: In this business, you, O chaste one, should help Rāma. Or having seen Mithila's daughter, as well as Rāma of untiring deeds, I shall come to your mouth, this I promise to you truly.'

sa: तस्य संनादशब्देन ते तेऽभवन् भयशङ्किताः। ददृशुश्च हनूमन्तं संध्यामेघमिवोन्नतम्॥
en: They were struck with affright at his roars; and they beheld Hanumān elevated as an evening cloud.

sa: पुष्पवर्षाणि मुश्चन्तो नगाः पवनताडिताः। शैलं तं वासयन्तीव मधुमाधवगन्धिनः॥
en: Being shaken by the wind the nectar-smelling trees made the hill fragrant with the shower of flowers.

sa: प्रवेशः केन दत्तोऽयमुभयोर्वैन्यसंसदि। उच्चैः समभिभाषन्तौ केन कार्येण धिष्ठितौ॥
en: Who did admit them to the court of Vainya? What is it that they are clamouring for?”

sa: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स्वयंभूरिदमब्रवीत्। शयिता ह्येष षण्मासमेकाहं जागरिष्यति॥
en: Hearing Rāvana's speech, the Self-sprung said, "having slept for six months, he shall wake for one day.

sa: भ्रामयन्तं कपिं दृष्ट्वा सालवृक्षं महाबलम्। चिक्षेप सुबहून्बाणाञ्जम्बुमाली महाबलः॥
en: Seeing the exceedingly strong monkey whirling the Sāla tree, the highly powerful Jambumālī dischanged a many shafts.

sa: राक्षसेन्द्र महासन्सि रामगरुडो महान्। उद्धरिष्यति वेगेन वैनतेय इवोरगान्॥
en: Like to Garuda pulling up the snakes, the Garuda like Rāma shall pull up your snake-like Raksasas.

sa: तस्मिन्नेव ततः काले राजपुत्री त्वनिन्दिता। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं भूषणोत्तमभूषितम्॥ ततो दृष्ट्वैव वैदेही रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। प्रावेपत वरारोहा प्रावते कदली यथा॥
en: Thereupon beholding Răvaņa-the lord of Rākṣasas, gifted with youth and beauty and adorned with an excellent dress, that excellent and blameless daughter of a king, Vaidehī, trembled like to a plantain tree shaken by the wind.

sa: र्वक्षस्थले मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च। सुखप्रसुप्तं भुवि कुम्भकर्ण रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नुः॥
en: Then the Raksasas, drawing near, smote Kumbhakarņa sleeping sweetly in the chest with mountain-peaks, maces and clubs.

sa: ताभ्यामुभाभ्यां तरसा प्रसृष्टैर्विशिखैः शितैः॥ निरन्तरमिवाकाशं बभूव तमसा वृतम्।
en: They both kept ceaselessly showering feathered and sharpened shafts, the firmament was engulphed with a deep darkness.

sa: ते प्रविष्टा मधुवनं पालानाक्रम्य शक्तितः॥ अतिसर्गाच्च पटवो दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम्। पपुः सर्वे मधु तदा रसवत् फलमाददुः॥
en: And entering that orchard they forcibly attacked the waiters there. Hanuman Maithili, and others heard of her from him-and those monkeys,-renouncing all fear in consequence and obtaining permission, drank honey and feasted on various sweet fruits.

sa: तेषु वानरमुख्येषु दीप्तोल्कोज्ज्वलपाणिषु। स्थितेषु द्वारमाश्रित्य रावणं क्रोध आविशत्॥
en: As the principal monkeys stationed themselves at the gate, equipped with fire-brands, wrath took possession of Rävana.

sa: अस्थीनि मेघा ववृषुरुष्णं शोणितमेव च। वेला समुद्राश्चोत्क्रान्ताश्चेलुश्चाप्यथ भूधराः॥
en: The clouds showered down bones and hot blood. The oceans overleapt their continents and the mountains shook.

sa: धिक्त्वां पापसमाचारं यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी। नृशंसानार्य दुर्वृत्त क्षुद्र पापपराक्रम। अनार्यस्येदृशं कर्म घृणा ते नास्ति निघृण ॥
en: O! cursed are you, since you have cherished such a desire and engaged in such a vicious deed. O vile! O wicked! O! cruel and dishonourable wight! O you having vice for your prowess!

sa: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः। परं परुषया वाचा वैदेहीमिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: And approaching Sītā that terrible host, almost faint with ire, addressed Vaidehī with the following harsh words.

sa: सा भय॑माना भीमाभी राक्षसीभिर्वराङ्गना। सा वाष्पमपमार्जन्ती शिंशपां तामुपागमत्॥
en: Being thus remonstrated with by those terrible Raksasis, that excellent damsel, shedding tears, neared the ſinsapa tree.

sa: ततो दैवतसैन्यानां संक्षोभः समजायत। तदक्षयं महासैन्यं दृष्ट्वा समरमूर्धनि॥
en: Thereupon beholding that inexhaustible huge army at the commencement of the battle the celestial host lost heart.

sa: श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः। संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Hanuman's words, Ravana possessed of dreadful prowess, with his eyes reddened in wrath, said these words.

sa: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे गर्जन्तो जयकाक्षिणः। अभ्यवर्षस्ततो घोरं वानराशरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thereat all those Raksasas, eager for victory, smiting roars, covered the dreadful monkeys with showers of shafts.

sa: बालानां वरनारीणां सहस्रेण समावृतम्। समदानां करेणूनां सहस्रेणेव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: He was surrounded by a thousands of beautiful damsels like an elephant by a thousands of she-elephants.

sa: तमालोक्य महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। निवार्य शरजालानि विदुद्राव स रावणम्॥
en: Seeing Răvaņa, the exceedingly powerful Hanuman-son to the Wind-god, resisting that downpour of arrows, charged him vehemently.

sa: एकस्थानमता यत्र चत्वारः पुरुषर्षभाः॥ लोकपालसमाः शूराः कृतास्त्रा दृढविक्रमाः। रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमाल्लक्ष्मणश्च बिभीषणः॥ सुग्रीवश्च महातेजा महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः। एते शक्ताः पुरीं लङ्कां सप्राकारां सतोरणाम्॥ उत्पाट्य संक्रामयितुं सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः।
en: As these four persons have combined—like to the Lokapālas, heroic, accomplished in arms, and of steady prowess-viz., Dasaratha's son, Rama, the graceful Laksmana, Vibhisana, and the highly powerful Sugrīva, resembling the great Indra, these are capable of uprooting the city of Larkā—walls and gateways-and replacing her (on her former site), leave you the monkeys aside.

sa: ततस्तां शिंशपां सीता राक्षसीभिः समावृता। अभिगम्य विशालाक्षी तस्थौ शोकपरिप्लुता॥ तां कृशां दीनवदनां मलिनाम्बरवासिनीम्। भर्त्सयांचक्रिरे भीमा राक्षस्यस्ताः समन्ततः॥
en: The large eyed Sītā, encircled by the Rākşasīs, remained there sunk in grief. And all those hideous demons, showered reproaches, from all sides, on her, greatly reduced, of a poorly countenance, and wearing a soiled cloth.

sa: विषण्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं रावणात्मजम्। सौमित्रिं युद्धसंयुक्तं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः॥
en: Then Vibhīşaņa spoke to Sumitrā's son as he was fighting, “I find (inauspicious) signs in Rāvana's son.

sa: ततो वानरपत्नीनां सर्वासामेव शोभनम्। चकार यत्नात्कौसल्या प्रहृष्टा पुत्रवत्सला॥
en: Thereupon Kausalyā, delighted and fond of her son, herself with great care, decorated the wives of monkeys.

sa: स हताश्वो महातेजा भूमौ तिष्ठनिशाचरः। इन्द्रजित्परमक्रुद्धः संप्रजज्वाल तेजसा॥
en: Having his steeds slain, the night-rangerIndrajit, standing on the ground, waxing fiercely angered, flamed up in energy.

sa: ततः समरकोपेन ज्वलितो रघुनन्दनः।। चिच्छेद कार्मुकं तस्य दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्॥
en: Then the son of Raghu, flaming up in martial wrath, severed his* bow, displaying his fleethandedness. *Indrajit's.

sa: रावणोऽर्धसमाप्त तमुत्सृज्य नियमं तदा। नर्मदां पश्यते कान्तां प्रतिकूलां यथा प्रियाम्॥ पश्चिमेन तु तं दृष्ट्वा सागरोद्गारसंनिभम्। वर्धन्तमम्भसो वेगं पूर्वामाशां प्रविश्य तु।९।। ततोऽनुद्धान्तशकुनां स्वभावे परमे स्थिताम्। निर्विकाराङ्गनाभासामपश्यद्रावणो नदीम्॥
en: Having given up his worship which was halffinished Rāvana looked towards Narmadā looking like an unwilling damsel and saw that she, with rising currents, was flowing towards the east from the west and the waters beyond that were in a natural state like a quiet lady and the birds were seated there without any anxiety.

sa: स्त्री चेति मन्यमानेन नातिक्रोधः स्वयं कृतः। सा तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलाङ्गी निशाचरी। पपात सहसा भूमौ विकृताननदर्शना ॥
en: Considering that she was a female he did not give way to excessive wrath. And struck at (by Hanumān), that ranger of the night, of a deformed face, her body overcome, suddenly dropped to the earth.

sa: इति चिन्तापरश्चासीदप्रमत्तश्च संयुगे। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि राघवो रावणोरसि ॥
en: Thinking thus Rāghava made himself ready in the conflict and began to shower arrows on Rāvana's breast.

sa: इदानीं त्वहमव्यग्रो गतमन्युर्गतज्वरः। मध्यमं पाण्डवं वीरं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि माधव॥
en: Now, I am free from wrath and fever. I wish eagerly, O Madhava to embrace that hero.

sa: ततः सर्वाण्यनीकानि स्थापयित्वा विभीषणः। आजगाम गदापाणिस्त्वरितं यत्र राघवः॥
en: Then Vibhisana, quieting the army, taking a mace in his hand, swiftly went to where Rāghava was.

sa: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः। ववर्ष शरवर्षेण राक्षसेन्द्रसुतं प्रति॥
en: Hearing Vibhisana's.words, Laksmana graced with auspicious marks began to shower arrows on the son of the Raksasa-chief.

sa: तमुवाच महाप्राज्ञः सोऽभिवाद्य प्लवंगमः। रामं कमलपत्राक्षं वरं सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: Thereupon bowing to Rāma, the foremost of bowmen, having eyes, resembling lotus-petals, the highly wise monkey said.

sa: छायावैगुण्यमानं तु शङ्के दुःखमुपस्थितम्। अदुःखार्हामिमां देवीं वैहायसमुपस्थिताम् ॥
en: And I saw in my dreams) this worshipful damsel, unworthy of any misfortune, stationed in the welkin.

sa: ततो विसृष्टा रामेण सर्वतो हरिपुङ्गवाः। उत्पेततुर्महारण्यं हृष्टाः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Then directed by Rāma, the principal monkeys with alacrity entered the mighty forest in hundreds and thousands.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति लोकांस्त्रीन्सर्वे दानवराक्षसाः। भयेन प्रभृता नित्यं विचरिष्यन्ति शाश्वतम्॥
en: From today shall the Rākṣasas and Dänavas roam for ever afraid of the celestials in three worlds,

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं राघवः शोककर्शितः। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding that excellent jewel, Rāghava, stricken with grief, with eyes full of tears, spake to Sugriva, saying.

sa: दशास्यो विंशतिभुजः प्रगृहीतशरासनः॥ अदृश्यत दशग्रीवो मैनाक इव पर्वतः।
en: The Ten-necked one having ten faces and twenty arms, equipped with his bow, looked like the mountain-Mainaka.

sa: यावद्विक्रमितुं बुद्धिं चक्रुः प्लवगपुङ्गवाः। तावदेतानतिक्रम्य निर्बिभेद नरान्तकाः। ७०॥
en: When the monkeys set their hearts on displaying their prowess, Narāntaka, baffling them, pierced them with shafts.

sa: तमेव दिवसं सोऽथ रावणस्तत्र आगतः। रावणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तस्यामात्यानपृच्छत॥
en: At the very same day, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, arrived there and asked his councillors saying.

sa: पततां हरिवीराणां रूपाणि प्रचकाशिरे। वभिन्नाग्रकूटानां शैलानां पततामिव। ७७।।
en: The appearances of those monkey-heroes falling were like mountains toppling, having their summits riven with the thunder-bolt.

sa: उद्यम्य गिरिशृङ्गाणि महान्ति शिखराणि च। तरूंश्चोत्पाट्य विविधांस्तिष्ठन्ति हरियूथपाः॥
en: The monkey-leaders stood, raising up gigantic mountain peaks and tops of mountains, and rooting up various trees.

sa: अर्थेभ्योऽथ प्रवृद्धेभ्यः संवृत्तेभ्यस्ततस्ततः। क्रियाः सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते पर्वतेभ्य इवापगाः॥
en: Like streams issuing out mountains, all acts spring from wealth flowing from various regions and attaining magnitude.

sa: स ददर्श वृतां लङ्कां सशैलवनकाननाम्। असंख्येयैर्हरिंगणैः सर्वतो युद्धकाटिभिः॥
en: He saw Lanka with her hills, woods, and forests, covered everywhere with innumerable monkeys eager for encounter.

sa: ततः समरकोपेन संयुतो रावणात्मजः। विभीषणं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध वदने शुभे॥
en: Then Ravana's son, carried away by martial rage, pierced Vibhīşaņa in his handsome face with three arrows.

sa: तस्मिन्विकृष्टे सहसा राघवेण शरासने। रोदसी संपफालेव पर्वताश्च चकम्पिरे॥
en: As Rāghava suddenly stretched his bow, heaven and earth seemed to be riven, and the mountains trembled.

sa: ततः पश्चात्सुमहती पृतनक्षवनौकसाम्। प्रच्छाद्य महती भूमिमनुयाति स्म राघवम्।।२८
en: Behind them, the mighty array of bears and monkeys followed Rāghava, severing a wide surface of land.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दो नर्मदातीरगो बभौ। अर्जुनस्यानुयात्राणां रावणस्य च मन्त्रिणाम्॥
en: There arose a dreadful uproar on the banks of Narmada, of the councillors of Răvana and Arjuna.

sa: एवं स रावणः प्राप्तः कार्तवीर्यात्प्रधर्षणम्। पुलस्त्यवचनाच्चापि पुनर्मुक्तो महाबलः॥
en: O Rāma, in this wise, the highly powerful Ravana was defeated by Arjuna and released by Pulastya.

sa: तस्मिन्प्रहर्तुकामे तु यमे दण्डेन रावणम्। यमं पितामहः साक्षादर्शयित्वेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: On Yama being desirous of slaying Rāvana, by his rod, the great-father manifesting himself spoke to Yama.

sa: दृष्टा देवीति हनुमद्वदनादमृतोपमम्। आकर्ण्य वचनं रामो हर्षमाप सलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Hearing from Hanumān the sweet words that he had beheld Sītā, Rāma and Lakşmana were greatly delighted.

sa: अहं ते यद्यनुग्राह्यो यदि स्मरसि मे गुणान्। वस तावदिह प्राज्ञ यद्यस्ति मयि सौहृदम्॥ लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या भार्यया सह। अर्चितः सर्वकामैस्त्वं ततो राम गमिष्यसि॥
en: If I am worthy of being favoured by you, if remember any accomplishment of mineif you have any friendship for me, do you, o wise one, wait here with your brother Lakşmaņa and spouse Vaidehi till I accomplish all my desires by worshipping you. And then you shall go (to Ayodhyā).

sa: ततो निहत्य तरसा रामो वालिनमाहवे। सर्वक्षहरिसङ्घानां सुग्रीवमकरोत् पतिम्॥
en: And destroying Vāli by his prowess in battle, Rāma made Sugrīva king over all monkeys and bears.

sa: विरूपाक्षस्तु महता शूलमुद्गधनुष्मता। बलेन राक्षसैः सार्धं मध्यमं गुल्ममाश्रितः॥
en: Virüpākṣa with a powerful force accoutred in javelins, clubs and bows, protects the garrison in the centre.

sa: तेऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाश्च मुदान्विताः। निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च॥
en: Those heroes headed by Angada, delighted and intoxicated, descended before Rāghava and the lord of the monkeys.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वानरश्रेष्ठो वारयन्सर्ववानरान्। शनैः शनैरसंत्रस्तः सबलः संन्यवर्तत ॥
en: Saying this and desisting all the monkeys from encounter that foremost of monkeys proceeded undaunted and heroically.

sa: श्रुतमेतन्मया पूर्वं सर्वमेव तपोधन॥ विस्तरश्रवणे जातं कौतूहलमतीव मे।
en: I have heard everything before, O Rishi, but iny curiosity is great for hearing it in detail!'

sa: अमी च धर्मकामास्त्वां क्षत्रियाः पर्युपासते। त्वदाशामभिकाङ्क्षन्तः कृपणाः फलहेतुका॥
en: These helpless Kshatriyas, expecting fruits of religious merit, wait upon you, placing all their hopes on you.

sa: स शरैः सर्वतो विद्धः प्रहष्ट इव पाण्डवः। अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय रथमारुह्य वेगवान्॥ अतिष्ठत रणे वीरः क्रुद्धरूप इवान्तकः।
en: Though wounded with arrows all over his body the valiant and heroic son of Pandu cheerfully took up another bow after getting upon another car and stood in battle like the angry Destroyers himself,

sa: ब्रूयाः संजय राजानं प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम्। दुर्योधनस्तव सुतः प्रविष्टो हृदमित्युत॥
en: Say, O Sanjaya, to the blind king Dhritarashtra, that his son Duryodhana has entered into a lake.

sa: अस्त्रमस्त्रेण तु रणे तव संशमयिष्यता। विसृष्टमर्जुनेनेदं पुनश्च प्रतिसंहृतम्॥
en: Arjuna, on the other hand, let it off for baffling your weapon. He has again withdrawn it.

sa: अनेयस्त्ववमानी यो दुरात्मा पापपूरुषः। दिष्टमुत्सृज्य कल्याणं करोति बहुपापकम्॥
en: A sinful person of ungovernable, irreverent, wicked soul, commits sin in seeking his welfare by neglecting destiny.

sa: ततो रथाश्च बहुला नागाश्वसमलंकृताः। पादाताश्च हयाश्चैव पृष्ठतः समनुव्रजन्॥
en: Then followed a large number of cars and elephants adorned with ornaments, and the infantry and horses.

sa: एष एव तु सर्वेषामकार्याणां विधिर्भवेत्। ब्राह्मणोक्तेन विधिना दृष्टान्तागमहेतुभिः॥
en: These, O king, are the expiations for sins, as laid down in scriptures and by Brahmana himself.

sa: वासुदेवे गते राजन् धृतराष्ट्र जनेश्वरम्॥ आश्वासयदमेयात्मा व्यासो लोकनमस्कृतः।
en: After Vasudeva had gone, O king, Vyasa, worshipped of the whole world, began to comfort king Dhritarashtra.

sa: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा वाग्विदां प्रवरः प्रभुः॥ भीष्मः परमधर्मात्मा वासुदेवमथास्तुवत्।
en: With joined hands, that foremost of orators, that powerful Bhishma of highly virtuous soul, thus praised Vasudeva.

sa: दधिवाहनपौत्रस्तु पुत्रो दिविरथस्य च॥ गुप्तः स गौतमेनासीद् गङ्गाकूलेऽभिरक्षितः।
en: Dadhivahana's grandson and Diviratha's son was kept hidden on the banks of Ganga by the sage Gautama.

sa: सा तानेकैकशः पुत्रान् संस्पृशन्तीं पुनः पुनः॥ अन्वशोचत दुःखार्ता द्रौपदी च हृतात्मजाम्। रुदतीमथ पाञ्चालीं ददर्श पतितां भुवि॥
en: She then repeatedly embraced and patted each of her sons, and stricken with grief wept with Draupadi who had lost all her children and whom she saw lying on the naked Earth, piteously bewailing.

sa: यूथानीव किशोरीणां सुकेशीनां जनार्दन। स्नुषाणां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पश्य वृन्दान्यनेकशः॥
en: Look, O Janarddana, at those Dhritarashtra's daughters-in-law, resembling a number of beautiful fillies adorned with excellent manes.

sa: भगवानपि तच्छास्त्रं संचिक्षेप पुरंदरः। सहस्रैः पञ्चभिस्तात यदुक्तं बाहुदन्तकम्॥
en: The divine Indra again abridged it into a work containing five thousand chapters and named it Vahudantaka.

sa: प्रशंसन्तोऽर्जुनं केचित् वेपमानास्तथातुराः। व्यद्रवन्त दिशो भीताः कुरवः कुरुसत्तम॥
en: The great car-warriors of the Kuru army fled away in fear some praising Karna and other Arjuna.

sa: श्रुत्वा हि धृतराष्ट्रश्च दुर्योधनवचस्तदा। अब्रवीत् कर्णसहितं दुर्योधनमिदं वचः॥
en: Having heard the words of Duryodhana, Dhritarashtra, addressing his son and Karna, replied to him as follows.

sa: दानमेव हि सर्वत्र सान्त्वेनानभिजल्पितम्। न प्रीणयति भूतानि निर्व्यञ्जनमिवाशनम्॥
en: Even gifts, if not made with sweet speeches, do not please the recipients, like rice without curry.

sa: तास्तुं यत्नेन महता संनिवार्य महारथान्। पुत्रस्ते योधयामास पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: Rallying their great car-warriors however, with vigorous exertions, your sons continued to fight with the Pandava army.

sa: ततस्तस्य महाशोकः प्रादुरासीन्महात्मनः। स्मरत: पुत्रपौत्राणां भ्रातृणां स्वजनस्य ह॥
en: Recollecting those sons and grandsons and brothers and allies, the king was stricken with a deep sorrow.

sa: विज्ञायातीतवयसं रुषहुं ते तपोधनाः तं च तीर्थमुपानिन्युः सरस्वत्यास्तपोधनम्॥
en: Knowing their father had become very old, those ascetics took him to a tirtha on the Sarasvati.

sa: यस्याहमुखे सौम्य स्थिता नैवोपपद्यते। स कथं दुर्मुखोऽमित्रैर्हतो विबुधलोकजित्॥
en: O amiable one, how could that Durmukha, before whom no enemy could stand be killed by foes.

sa: कार्यार्थमुपसम्प्राप्ता देवतानां समीपतः। उपगम्य तदा धात्री देवानाह समागतान्॥ यत् कार्यं मम युष्माभिर्ब्रह्मणः सदने तदा। प्रतिज्ञातं महाभागास्तच्छीघ्रं संविधीयताम्॥
en: The latter had gone to the gods for the accomplishment of a particular mission. Approaching the gods, she said,—While you were in Brahman's abode you promised to do all for me. Let that be accomplished soon.

sa: दैत्याश्च दानवाश्चैव राक्षसाः पार्थिवास्तथा॥ क्रियाभ्युपायैर्निहताः क्रियां तस्मात् समाचर।
en: Daityas and Danavas and Rakshasas and king have been slain by the same. Do you, therefore, act.'

sa: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे मद्राधिपतिमञ्जसा । परिवार्य सुसंरब्धाः पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्॥
en: Smingly, all your warriors, enraged, quickly encompassed the king of the Madras and stood there for battle.

sa: वायुनेव विधूतानि तव सैन्यानि सर्वतः। शरदम्भोदजालानि व्यशीर्यन्त समन्ततः॥
en: The diverse detachments of your army are routed and dispersed like autumnal clouds scattered by the wind.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हताः पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च भ्रातरः पितरस्तथा। श्वशुरा गुरवश्चैव मातुलाश्च पितामहाः॥ क्षत्रियाश्च महात्मानः सम्बन्धिसुहृदस्तथा। वयस्या भागिनेयाश्च ज्ञातयश्च पितामह॥ बहवश्च मनुष्येन्द्रा नानादेशसमागताः। घातिता राज्यलुब्धेन मयैकेन पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Sons, grandsons, brothers, sires, fathers-inlaw, preceptors, maternal uncles, grandsires, many great Kshatriyas, many relatives, friends, companions, sisters' sons, and kinsmen, O grandfather, and many foremost of men hailing from various countries, have been killed. All these, O grandfather, have been caused to be killed by myself alone, from desire of kingdom.

sa: ततः पूर्वाह्नसमये शिबिरादेत्य संजयः। प्रविवेश पुरीं दीनो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः॥
en: Having left the camb next morning Sanjaya went to the Kuru capital depressed and laden with grief.

sa: मे पार्थिवसुतामेतां लक्ष्मणमातरम्। राजपुत्रीं महाबाहो मनो न ह्युपशाम्यति॥
en: Beholding this princess, this mother of Lakshmana, O you of mighty-arms, my heart is torn with sorrow.

sa: स्थिरं चातिस्थिरं चैव मेरुरेवापरौ ददौ॥ महात्मा त्वग्निपुत्राय महाबलपराक्रमौ।
en: Manu also gave Agni's son two others gifted with great strength and power viz., Sthira and Asthira.

sa: उवाच भरतश्रेष्ठ तावृषी प्राञ्जलिस्तदा। प्रमुक्तमस्त्रमस्त्रेण शाम्यतामिति वै मया॥
en: Joining his hands, he said to those Rishis,'I discharged this weapon, saying,—Let it neutralise the enemy's weapon.

sa: अनुमानेन युध्यन्ते संज्ञाभिश्च परस्परम्। तेषां क्षयो महानासीद् युध्यतामितरेतरम्॥
en: The warriors fought, knowing one another by the names they uttered. A great onslaught took place there.

sa: अथैरा निबद्ध्यन्ते गजैर्वनगजा इव। न च कश्चित् कृते कार्ये कर्तारं समवेक्षते॥ तस्मात् सर्वाणि कार्याणि सावशेषाणि कारयेत्।
en: Interest brings interest even as tame elephants catch wild elephants. Again, when a work is done, the doer is hardly thought of. Therefore, all works should be so done that something may remain undone.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं च परोक्षं च यो निशम्य श्रुतिं त्विमाम्। अधुवे जीवलोकेऽस्मिन् यो धर्ममनुपालयन्। जन्मप्रभृति वर्तेत प्राप्नुयात् परमां गतिम्॥
en: He who, looking at this scriptural injunction with his own eyes or hearing it from others, practises virtue in this unstable world of life and sticks to it from early age, attains to the highest end.

sa: ततः स्वाभिभवाद् भीतो बृहस्पतिमते स्थितः। कुमारस्यान्तरप्रेक्षी बभूव बलवृत्रहा॥
en: Fearing humiliation the slayer of Vala and Vritra began to watch for the loopholes in that prince.

sa: उन्माथमप्यथादाय चाण्डालो वीक्ष्य सर्वशः॥ विहताशः क्षणेनास्ते तस्माद् देशादपाक्रमत्।
en: Seeing everything, the hunter took up his net. His hopes defeated, he also quickly left that place.

sa: एवं स भगवांस्तस्मिंतीर्थे दैत्यकुलान्तकः अभिषिक्तो महाराज देवसेनापतिः सुरैः॥
en: Thus, O king was that adorable destroyer of the Daityas installed by the gods as their generalissimo.

sa: गतेषु तेषु वीरेषु धौम्योऽथ जपतां वरः। अग्निहोत्राण्युपादाय पाञ्चालानभ्यगच्छत॥
en: These heroes having departed, Dhaumya, the great among ascetics, took their Agnihotra fires and started for Panchalas.

sa: आहृत्य कृष्णो मणिकुण्डले ते हत्वा च भौमं नरकं मुरं च। श्रिया वृतो यशसा प्रत्याजगामाप्रतिमप्रभावः॥ चैव विद्वान्
en: Having killed Naraka, the son of the earth and Mura and taking back that pair of earrings bedecked with gems, the learned one endued with prosperity and fame and of unparalled proves came back.

sa: त वै विमनसं दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रेक्ष्यान्योन्यमन्तिकात्। पुनरेवोत्तरं वाक्यमुक्तवन्तौ नरर्षभौ॥
en: Seeing him absent-minded those two best among men glancing at each other again said the following words.

sa: यथा कैकेयि सैरन्ध्री समेयात् तद् विधीयताम्। येनोपायेन सैरन्ध्री भजेन्मां गजगामिनी। तं सुदेष्णे परीप्सस्व प्राणान् मोहात् प्रहासिषम्॥
en: O Kaikeyi, do that by which Sairandhri may be united with me. O Sudeshna, device a plan by which that Sairandhri of elephant-gait may accept me. Otherwise I intend putting end to my life.

sa: तदागमनजं हेतुं पप्रच्छ मधुसूदनः। ततो दुर्योधनः कृष्णमुवाच प्रहसन्निव॥
en: The son of Madhu asked the cause of their coming and Duryodhana said as if in jest-

sa: आभिषेचनिकं यत् ते रामार्थमुपकल्पिपतम्। भरतस्तदवाप्नोतु वनं गच्छतु राघवः॥
en: “Let Bharata be installed with the materials brought for Rama and let Raghava depart to the forests."

sa: ततः ससर्ज तं रामः शरमप्रतिमौजसम्॥ रावणान्तकरं घोरं ब्रह्मदण्डमिवोद्यतम्।
en: Rama then discharged that of unrivalled splendour, dreadful, resembling the upraised Brahmadanda and destined to slay Ravana.

sa: तमभिद्रुत्य कौन्तेयः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। कामयन् द्वैरथं तेन युद्धं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Approaching him and desiring a duel, the son of Kunti, having his eyes reddened with anger, said.

sa: अलब्धोपममन्यत्र तयोरेव तथाभवत्। स रामाय महाघोरं विससर्ज निशाचरः॥
en: And that (fight) between them is without its parallel elsewhere. The night-ranger hurled at Rama an awfully-terrible.

sa: अजाश्च कांस्यं रजतं च नित्यं मध्वाकर्षः शुकनिः श्रोत्रियश्च। वृद्धो ज्ञातिरवसन्नः कुलीन एतानि ते सन्तु गृहे सदैव।॥
en: Goats, white metal, silver, honey, that which draws away (poison), birds, Brahmanas having a knowledge of the holy books, old cousins, persons of good birth but poor, let these ever stay in your house.

sa: गावल्गणे ब्रुहि नः सारफल्गु स्वसेनायां यावदिहास्ति किंचित्। त्वं पाण्डवानां निपुणं वेत्थ सर्वं किमेषां ज्यायः किमु तेषा कनीयः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O son of Gavalgani, tell one of the little superiority that exists in our own army. You know the affairs of the Pandavas fuliy, in what points they are superior and in what inferior.

sa: सोऽहं प्राणान् विमोक्ष्यामि कृत्वा यलमनुत्तमम्। अर्थिता न मया काचित् कृतपूर्वा दिवौकसाम्। मानयन्ति च मां सर्वे त्रिदशा यज्ञसंस्तरे॥
en: I, who am such, shall cast off this life after having made an attempt which cannot be exceeded (by other attempts in point of earnestness). Never before has anything been asked by me from the gods.

sa: हर्येषु रमणीयेषु प्रासादशिखरेषु च। वातायनविमानेषु तथा गर्भगृहेषु च॥
en: In variegated gardens, and in forests and pleasure gardens, in beautiful palaces and on tops of houses.

sa: तत्रोपसदनं चक्रे द्रोणस्येष्वस्त्रकर्णमि। सख्यं दुर्योधनेनैवमगमत् स च वीर्यवान्॥
en: There the powerful youth lived with Drona in order to learn weapons and made friends with Duryodhana.

sa: मे युधिष्ठिर उवाच न ममैतन्मतं कृष्णं यत् त्वं यायाः कुरून् प्रति। सुयोधनः सूक्तमपि न करिष्यति ते वचः॥
en: Yudhishthira said It is not my wish, O Krishna, that you should go to the Kurus. For Suyodhana, though spoken in a most friendly manner and for his own good, will not listen to your words.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं मुक्तं भ्रातृभिः सहितस्तदा। युधिष्ठिरस्तु प्रणयादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira thus spoke out of affection to the liberated Duryodhana in the midst of his brothers.

sa: ये वै राजानः पाण्डवायोधनाय समानीताः शृण्वतां चापि तेषाम्। यथा समग्रं वचनं मृयोक्तं सहामात्यं श्रावयेथा नृपं तत्॥
en: And also in the hearing of those kings who have been assembled to fight the Pandavas, the entire collection of words used by me; let that king with his ministers hear what I say.

sa: अष्टादशेमे राजानः प्रख्याता मधुसूदन। ये समुच्चिच्छिदुर्शातीन् सुहृदश्च सबान्धवान्॥
en: These eighteen kings are well known, O destroyer of Madhu, who annihilated their cousins, friends all well-wishers.

sa: उत्सृज्यैव गृहान् यस्तु मोक्षमेवाभिमन्यते। लोकास्तेजोमयास्तस्य कल्पन्ते शाश्वता दिवि॥
en: He who desirous of emancipation leaves his home has in heaven bright regions assigned to him forever.

sa: दूषणावरजौ चैव वलावेगप्रमाथिनौ॥ तौ त्वां बलेन महता सहितावनुयास्यतः।
en: The two younger brothers of Dushana, Vajravega and Pramathin, accompanied by a mighty army will follow you."

sa: आदित्यानां हि सर्वेषां विष्णुरेकः सनातनः। अक्षय्यश्चाव्ययश्चैव शाश्वतः प्रभुरीश्वरः॥
en: Among all sons of Aditi, Vishnu alone is eternal, invincible, undecaying and the divine Lord existing forever.

sa: सादिताः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त बहवः सव्यसाचिना। सपताकाच मातङ्गाः सध्वजाश्च महारथाः॥
en: Many elephants with flags and great cars with standards were to have been destroyed by Savyasachi. seen

sa: अकस्मादेत्य च ब्रूते भोजयास्मांस्त्वरान्वितः। कदाचिच्च निशीथे स उत्थाय निकृतौ स्थितः॥ पूर्ववत् कारयित्वान्नं न भुङ्क्ते गर्हयन् स्म सः।
en: Sometimes suddenly coming, he would say "feed us soon.” At other times, being bent on mischief, he would awake at midnight and having ordered his food to be prepared, he would not eat it at all.

sa: ततः क्षत्तानपानानि शुचीनि गुणवन्ति च। उपाहरदनेकानि केशवाय महात्मने॥
en: Then the Kshatta collected large quantities of clean and delicious foods and drinks for the great-souled Keshava.

sa: उद्भवः क्षेमकश्चैव वाटधानश्च पार्थिवः। श्रुतायुश्च दृढायुश्च शाल्वपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: And Udbhava and Kshemaka and the king Vatadhana and Shrutayu and Dridhayu the valiant son of Shalva.

sa: दृढं सतां संगतं चापि नित्यं ब्रूयाच्चा) ह्यर्थकृच्छ्रेषु धीरः। महार्थवत् सत्पुरुषेण संगतं तस्मात् सन्तं न जिघांसेत धीरः॥
en: Wise men ever speak of firm friendship with virtuous men as wealth is times of pecuniary difficulties. The company of virtuous men is vast wealth indeed; therefore wise men should not injure virtuous ones.

sa: ततः समस्तास्ते सर्वे तुरगानभ्यचोदयन्। दिव्यमस्त्रं विकुर्वाणास्त्रिगर्तान् प्रत्यमर्षणाः॥ तान् निवृत्तरथान् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवान् सा महाचमूः। वैराटिः परमक्रुद्धो युयुधे परमाल्लुतम्॥
en: Beholding the Pandavas return to their cars the entire huge army urged on their horses and began to assail the Trigartas with excellent weapons. Virata's son, greatly enraged, began to display highly wonderful feats in battle.

sa: दुर्योधनस्यापि मतं च वेत्तुं वक्तुं च वाक्यानि युधिष्ठिरस्य। प्रियं च मे स्याद् यदि तत्र कश्चिद् व्रजेच्छमार्थं कुरुपाण्डवानाम्॥
en: I should be glad if some body were to go there to bring about good feelings among the Kauravas and the Pandavas, to know the intentions of Duryodhana and to tell them the views of Yudhishthira.

sa: इदं तु रूपं मम येन किं तव प्रकीर्तयित्वा भृशशोकवर्धनम्। बृहन्नलां मां नरदेव विद्धि सुतं सुतां वा पितृमातृवर्जिताम्॥
en: It will be of no avail to describe how I have come by this form. It will merely augment my pain, O lord of men; know me to be Brihannala, a son or daughter without parents.

sa: सा तमालक्ष्य सम्प्राप्तं धर्मज्ञा जनकात्मजा। निमन्त्रयामास तदा फलमूलाशनादिभिः॥
en: On perceiving him, the virtuous daughter of Janaka welcomed him by offering fruits roots and a seat.

sa: सा वनानि विचित्राणि रमणीयानि सर्वशः। मयूरगणजुष्टानि ददर्श विपुलेक्षणा॥३
en: And that large-eyed lady beheld, on all sides romantic and charming forests frequented by swarms of peacocks.

sa: तं चित्रमाल्याभरणाः कृतविद्या मनस्विनः। आगच्छन् भीमधन्वानं चत्वारच महाबलाः॥ दुःशासनो विकर्णश्च दुःसहोऽथ विविंशतिः। आगत्य भीमधन्वानं बीभत्सुं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: At this the four powerful heroes Dushasana, Vikarana, Dussaha and Vivinshati, skilled in the use of weapons, gifted with great energy and adorned with beautiful garlands and ornaments, approaching, withstood that dreadful bowman Bibhatsu.

sa: निर्दहन्निव चक्षुर्त्यां योऽसावास्ते तपोनिधिः। तं प्रलोभयितुं देव गच्छामः सहिता वयम्॥ यतिष्यामो वशे कर्तुं व्यपनेतुं च ते भयम्।
en: The great devotee who now sits, as if scorching with his eyes, O lord and whom we are going together to decoy. We shall try to get him under our control and thus destroy your fears.

sa: गुणैरनेकैः प्रवरैश्च युक्तो विज्ञानवान् नैव च निष्ठुरो यः। स्नेहादमर्षं सहते सदैव स सोमदत्तः पूजनीयो मतो मे॥
en: In my opinion Somadatta too should be saluted by you who is endued with many good qualities, wise and merciful and who always subdues his anger towards the Kurus out of affection for them.

sa: महद् बलं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य राज्ञः को वै शक्तो हन्तुमक्षीयमाणः। सोऽहं जये चैव पराजये च निःश्रेयसं नाधिगच्छामि किञ्चित्॥
en: Who is capable of staying, without any loss to his own army, the large force of the royal son of Dhritarashtra? Therefore do I see not the slightest good in either victory or defeat.

sa: आसनं सर्वतोभद्रं जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृतम्। कृष्णार्थं कल्पितं तत्र धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: A seat respectable in every way and adorned with gold was placed there under instructions from Dhritarashtra.

sa: तादृशान्येव सर्वाणि बलवन्ति दृढानि च। युधिष्ठिरस्य भीमस्य बीभत्सोर्यमयोस्तथा॥
en: The other bows, that there of Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna and twins are equally strong and tough. are

sa: ततः शतसहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। युगपत् प्रापतस्तत्र द्रोणस्य रथमन्तिकात्॥
en: Then simultaneously hundreds and thousands of arrows with depressed knots came down upon the car of Drona.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मानं हित्वा प्रियो भवति क्रोधं हित्वा न शोचति। कामं हित्वार्थवान् भवति लोभं हित्वा सुखी भवेत्।।७८।
en: Yudhishthira replied It is the sense of pride which, if given up, makes one dear. Abandonment of anger never leads to misery. Desire, if it is renounced, makes one wealthy. Abandonment of avarice makes one happy.

sa: त्वष्टा पूषा तथैवेन्द्रो द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते। इत्येते द्वादशादित्याः कश्यपस्यात्मसम्भवाः॥
en: Tashtri, Pushan, Indra, and Vishnu know as the twelfth,-these are the twelve Adityas, all originated from Kashyapa.

sa: ततोऽस्य वितते यज्ञे नष्टोऽभूद्धव्यवाहनः। ततःसुदुःखितो राजा वाक्यमाह द्विजांस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon Agni disappeared from his great sacrifice. The king, grieved at heart, then addressed the Brahmanas, saying,

sa: इहैव चागतोऽस्म्पद्य विसृष्टः परमात्मना॥ को हि नाम भवेत् तस्य तेजसा यशसा श्रिया। सदृशस्त्रिषु लोकेषु ऋते धर्मात्मजौ युवाम्॥
en: Dismissed by the Supreme Soul, I have come here to-day. In energy, fame and beauty, who else in the three worlds can equal Him than you two who have been born in the race of Dharma.

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां प्रज्ञा लाभः परो मतः। प्रज्ञा निःश्रेयसी लोके प्रज्ञा स्वर्गो मतः सताम्॥
en: Bhishma said 'Wisdom is the refuge of creatures. Wisdom is considered as the greatest of acquisitions. Wisdom is the greatest happiness in the world. Wisdom is regarded by the good and virtuous as heaven.

sa: कुण्डधार उवाच मां पूजयित्वा भावेन यदि त्वं दुःखमाप्नुयाः। कृतं मया भवेत् किं ते कश्च तेऽनुग्रहो भेवत्॥
en: Kundadhara said After having adored me with devotion you had got sorrow for your share, what then would have been the good done to you by me, and what the value of my favour.

sa: उपेतार्थमभिन्नार्थं न्यायवृत्तं न चाधिकम्। नाश्लक्ष्णं न च संदिग्धं वक्ष्यामि परमं ततः॥ न गुर्वक्षरसंयुक्तं पराङ्मुखसुखं न च। नानृतं न त्रिवर्गेण विरुद्धं नाप्यसंस्कृतम्॥ न न्यूनं कष्टशब्दं वा विक्रमाभिहितं न च। न शेषमनु कल्पेन निष्कारणमहेतुकम्॥
en: The words I shall utter will have senses, be free from ambiguity, logical, free from tautology, smooth, certain, free from bombast, agreeable, or sweet truthful, not inconsistent with the three-1 old objects of life, refined not elliptical or imperfect, shorn of harshness or difficulty of comprehension, characterised by due order, not far-fetched in sense, corrected with one another as cause and effect, and each having a specific object.

sa: दस्यूनां दीयतामेष साध्वद्य पुरुषाधमः॥ इत्यूचुस्ते महाराज राक्षसेन्द्रं निशाचराः।
en: Indeed, those night-rangers addressing their king, said,-Let this vilest of men be handed over to the robbers.
